Goal: Can MVFA's few-shot fusion be made inductive — scoring each image on its own, without the test-set min-max normalisation of the released code — without losing AUROC, and does this give a threshold that transfers to unseen modalities? Hypothesis to revise: TITLE: Fisher p-value fusion with region-mass image scoring and support-derived thresholds
SUMMARY: Fuse MVFA's levels and branches per pixel with Fisher's statistic over empirical p-values against the support normals, and score each image by its strongest coherent region, so both fusion and pooling are per-image and outlier-robust.
HYPOTHESIS: Fisher fusion with region-mass pooling keeps image AUROC within 1 point of MVFA's transductive fusion on held-out BMAD modalities (K >= 4), reduces false positives per image at the support threshold by at least 25% relative to Fisher with max pooling, and is at least as stable under test-set subsampling as LOO-Z with region mass.
RATIONALE: The two parents fix the two verified defects (transductive fusion; single-pixel max), but parent 1 uses Gaussian-style z-scores (reviewed as a rough tail approximation) while parent 2 uses calibrated p-values with plain top-2% pooling. Taking the stronger fusion (Fisher) and the stronger pooling (region mass) gives a two-component per-image scorer in which every number has a probabilistic meaning: a region is flagged when its pixels are jointly improbable under the support normals.
METHOD: 1) Null scores per branch/level from support LOO as in Fisher-MVFA; empirical p via searchsorted with floor 1/(N+1). 2) Pixel statistic X = -2 sum log p over 8 terms, upsampled to 240x240. 3) Pixel threshold t = 99th percentile of support LOO X; 8-connected components of X > t; image score = max_c mean(X_c) log(1 + |c|). 4) Image threshold = 95th percentile of support LOO image scores. 5) Code: scoring.py combining fisher_map() and region_mass(); test_few.py per image.
EXPERIMENT: BMAD leave-one-modality-out (RESC and OCT17 held out together); MVFA checkpoints selected on source-modality validation splits and the MVFA baseline re-run the same way; K in {2,4,8,16}; 3 seeds x 3 support draws, mean and std. Baselines: transductive MVFA; Fisher + top-2%; LOO-Z + region mass. Metrics: image/pixel AUROC, PRO, FP per image, sensitivity/specificity at thresholds, AUROC std over 20 test subsamples, spike-corruption robustness. Falsification: AUROC loss > 2 points or no FP reduction.
